## Plan / implementation

- `crates/hh-assembly/src/grammar.rs` — `ProfileBinding::Constraint`
  now carries `ProfileConstraint{selector, required_capabilities,
  fallback_profile}` (was opaque `Json`); `ConstraintSelector`
  `{provider_api_family?, model_family?, version_pattern?,
  roles_admitted?}` spells the profile record's own member names (CC7);
  closed-member codec — unknown members are typed `C-LOAD-1`
  diagnostics, `constraint`+pin exclusivity refuses, vacuous `{}`
  decodes to the vacuous constraint; `profile_binding_from_json`
  exported as the one decoder.
- `crates/hh-assembly/src/compose.rs` — the C2 organisation-layer
  ordering: `check_org_cap_ordering` collects each `organisation`
  layer's `authority_cap` subjects at their lowest precedence; a
  `user`/`project`/`experiment`/`session` cap on the same `of` subject
  at equal-or-higher precedence is `C-COMP-1` naming the inverted
  layer; `packaged-default` is kernel-authored, outside the ordering.
  A fragment authoring the derived `layers[]`/`resolved` members
  refuses `C-COMP-4` (typed, never silently dropped).
- `crates/hh-assembly/src/validate.rs` — `bound_profile_coordinates`
  names a `ProfileConstraint`'s `fallback_profile` so stages 6a/6b
  sweep it (one definition, CC7).
- `crates/hh-assembly/src/diagnostics.rs` — latent-table fixes the
  corpus surfaced: `Code::all()` was missing `ClassSlotUnbound`
  (C-CLASS-2); `KERN_VARIANTS` was missing eight `HirError` mirrors
  (`RemovalTestRefusal`, `EmptyEffectSet`, `UnmappedParameter`,
  `UnscopedParameter`, `LiftedDeclarationsNotUnverified`,
  `ExactCostUnmeasured`, `DerivedEffectsMismatch`,
  `NoDiscoverySurface`); the spelling map was missing `C-PARAM-6` and
  `C-EXT-1`..`-4`.
- `crates/hh-compiler/src/link.rs` — `link` decodes the sealed
  assembly's `profile_binding` through the grammar codec (a malformed
  constraint reaching link refuses — never skipped) and runs
  `check_profile_constraint` against the bound chain head →
  `LinkError{VersionConflict}` minting `C-LINK-4`; `version_pattern`
  narrowing is conservative subsumption (unprovable → refused);
  `required_capabilities` axes must read `declared | probed` —
  `unknown` never coerces; `constraint.fallback_profile` supplies the
  ADR-0124 §5 coordinate when the caller passes none — dated
  hypothesis required (`expiry.is_dated()`), `is_fallback` marked.
- `crates/hh-ontology/src/eval.rs` — `VersionPattern` moved here as
  the one canonical definition (`hh-compiler` re-exports — CC7, the
  `ModelRole` convention) + `version_pattern_json` /
  `version_pattern_from_json` / `pattern_subsumes`.
- `crates/hh-compiler/src/schema.rs` / `profile.rs` — the
  `version_pattern` codec delegates to the `hh-ontology::eval` pair;
  `VersionPattern` re-exported.
- `crates/hh-lab/src/assembly/desugar.rs` — the override grammar
  decodes `profile_binding` through `profile_binding_from_json` (CC7);
  failures mint `C-LOAD-1`.
- `crates/hh-assembly/tests/ac_cc_11.rs` — the corpus: `Row`/`Cov`
  honest-classification INDEX over `Code::all()` (95 codes), the
  `index_covers_the_closed_code_table` drift leg (INDEX ↔ closed
  table pinned both directions; external/unemittable rows must name
  their honest owner), `each_fixture_rejects_with_exactly_its_code`,
  `planted_multi_error_returns_every_diagnostic` (never fail-fast),
  `fuzzed_corpus_yields_no_c_int_1` (600 xorshift64-seeded mutations —
  every refusal lands on a named code, no panic).
- Batteries: `hh-assembly/tests/r2_18.rs` (15 — codec legs,
  exclusivity/typed refusals, org-ordering matrix, `C-COMP-4`),
  `hh-compiler/tests/r2_18.rs` (11 — satisfaction legs, subsumption,
  capability no-coerce, fallback binding incl. dated-hypothesis and
  satisfies-the-constraint legs).
- `docs/adr/ADR-0350` — the five owned rulings + the latent-defect
  record.
